searchText: <@!184800644266196992> very interesting this contract, did you see the decompiled source? https://etherscan.io/bytecode-decompiler?a=0xa619651c323923ecd5a8e5311771d57ac7e64d87 I wonder what are the incentives on setting and cleaning the storage slots on this contract... Maybe is some sort of signal? Someone already used 217.59 Eth as gas in this <@!551157969367334912> it appears to be an arbitrageur account. My guess is that he's calling this function everytime he needs to drop & replace a pending transaction that he's no longer interesting of executing (i.e: back-running tx that won't execute in time?)
